tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen gyi lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ swa bha wa shūddha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ padma maṇḍa la/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ ru tra baṃ/ padma nyi zla bdud nag pho mo'i gdan gyi steng du/ hrīḥspha ra na phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐/ hrīḥyig dmar nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid padma dbang chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi beng chen nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa la bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'bar ba dang / dbu gtsug na rta mgo sngo ljang rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ tshal dbus dpung rgyan thod pa skam rlon lnga bcu tshar gsum gyis do shal byas pa/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang rin po che'i phreng bas sku la spras pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/

stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon po gdengs pas bar snang khengs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad padma dbang chen gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣ-iñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rang gi thugs kar padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ badzra kro dha ha yaṃ gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kha dog dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi rgyud sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam zhing / hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha yaṃ gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ha yaṃ gṛ wa/ arghaṃ/ padyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhuṣpe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi te/ shapta pra titstsha ye swāhā/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hī/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun bdag chos sku padma'i gdung / /chos rje 'od dpag med pa chos rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngams chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas mchod cing bstod/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /padma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la/ /rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog

/ces pa'i smon lam btab/ de ltar khrag 'thung dpa' gcig gi /sgrub thabs nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di/ /dang po'i las can nyams len phyir/ /bandhe blo gsal rgya mtshos sbyar// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ padmadabang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
